input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets the preferred position: Services are warranted to be performed professionally and in a workmanlike manner by qualified personnel (19.1), Deliverables conform to documentation and acceptance criteria for ninety days measured from the later of delivery or acceptance and Hosted Services conform throughout the subscription term (19.2), and Vendor warrants no intentionally introduced malicious code and compliance with Applicable Law (19.3). The remedy in 19.4 is re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, escalating to termination and refund of Fees paid, and is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, IP, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The disclaimer in 19.5 is mutual and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranty. Section 6 acceptance testing does not shorten the warranty (the 90-day period runs from the later of delivery or acceptance) and Section 3 reinforces the performance standard. No redline needed.
